key.name: skin
key.summary: Skin of the shell-side UI
key.description: Which UI variant and stylesheet the bridge uses for its panels. Themes set it in their look module (desk.dconf).

key.name: language
key.summary: Interface language
key.description: 'system' follows the session locale (LANGUAGE, LC_MESSAGES); 'uk' or 'en' overrides it for desktop-themes-rs only (the window, the themes command, deskd and desk-bridge).

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Record clipboard history
key.description: Turn off to disable the feature completely

key.name: history-size
key.summary: Maximum number of unpinned items
key.description: How many unpinned items to keep

key.name: images
key.summary: Record images
key.description: Also record copied images

key.name: image-max-kb
key.summary: Largest image recorded, in KiB
key.description: Bigger images are not recorded

key.name: image-budget-mb
key.summary: Total size of the images in the history, in MiB (oldest images are dropped first)
key.description: Images wait in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (memory), so their total is capped; nothing is written when that directory is nearly full.

key.name: persist
key.summary: Keep text history across sessions
key.description: Stored in ~/.local/share/deskd/clipboard (mode 0600).

key.name: persist-images
key.summary: Keep images across sessions
key.description: Off by default: images live only in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR while the session runs.

key.name: private-mode
key.summary: Private mode: record nothing
key.description: Temporarily record nothing

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste the selected item into the focused window
key.description: After you choose an item it is pasted into the window you were working in

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the clipboard panel (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default here from desk.dconf (Super+V for Windows 11, Shift+Super+V for macOS); an override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts clipboard-toggle replaces it and is re-applied after every theme apply. Change it in the window (Keyboard shortcuts) or with `themes shortcut`.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: Applications whose copies are never recorded (WM class or app id)

key.name: clipboard-toggle
key.summary: Your shortcut for the clipboard panel (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: mixer-open
key.summary: Your shortcut for the volume mixer (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Enable the volume mixer
key.description: Volume of each application and the choice of output and input devices

key.name: entry-point
key.summary: Where the mixer opens
key.description: 'menu': inside the volume menu of quick settings only; 'menu-and-icon': a secondary click on the system area of the top bar opens it directly as well.

key.name: show-silent-apps
key.summary: List applications with a paused audio stream
key.description: Also list applications that keep a sound stream open without playing

key.name: remember-app-volume
key.summary: Restore the volume set for an application when it plays again
key.description: Stored in ~/.local/share/deskd/mixer/apps.json (mode 0600): application ids with a volume and a mute flag. Turning it off forgets them and deletes the file.

key.name: volume-step
key.summary: Slider step for the arrow keys, in percent
key.description: How much an arrow key changes a slider (Shift: 1 %)

key.name: hide-apps
key.summary: Application keys (app id or program name) never listed in the mixer

key.name: mixer-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the volume mixer (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default here from desk.dconf (Ctrl+Super+V for Windows 11; none for macOS and Fedora, which have no such key); an override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts mixer-open replaces it. The key is not called toggle-shortcut because shell keybinding names are global.

key.name: mode
key.summary: Colour scheme mode
key.description: How deskd manages org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme: 'manual' leaves it alone, 'light' and 'dark' keep it fixed, 'auto-sun' follows local sunrise and sunset, and 'auto-time' switches at dark-from and light-from.

key.name: dark-from
key.summary: Time to switch to dark mode (HH:MM, 24-hour)
key.description: Time to switch to dark mode (HH:MM, 24-hour)

key.name: light-from
key.summary: Time to switch to light mode (HH:MM, 24-hour)
key.description: Time to switch to light mode (HH:MM, 24-hour)

key.name: location
key.summary: City name or coordinates (lat,lon) for sunrise and sunset
key.description: Used locally to compute sunrise and sunset (no network requests). Accepts a city name from the built-in table or decimal coordinates 'lat,lon'; empty falls back to the system timezone.

key.name: twilight-offset
key.summary: Shift sunrise and sunset earlier (negative) or later (positive), in minutes
key.description: Shift sunrise and sunset earlier (negative) or later (positive)

key.name: override-until-next
key.summary: Keep manual light/dark changes until the next scheduled transition
key.description: If you switch light or dark manually, wait until the next sunrise or sunset before switching back

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Show the logo menu on the left of the top bar in the macOS skin
key.description: Show a system menu on the left of the top bar in the macOS skin.

key.name: hide-activities
key.summary: Hide the default Activities indicator while the logo menu is shown
key.description: Hide the default Activities indicator while the logo menu is shown.
